name: Noble M600 Carbon Sport
description: The Noble M600 is a handbuilt British supercar made by Noble Automotive in Leicestershire. It is made from stainless steel and carbon fibre and uses a twin turbocharged 4.4-litre Volvo-derived Yamaha V8 producing 650 bhp and 960 Nm of torque. The Carbon Sport edition features enhanced aerodynamics and lightweight carbon fibre components for improved performance.
author: Velo
